summary: Dichiarazioni d'intento / plafond feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (CRUD, protocol normalization 23-digit and '/', invalid->400, duplicate->400 incl. '/' vs '-' variant, plafond<=0 ->422, revoca<data ->400, CSRF 403, usage/residuo/percentuale/livello ok/attenzione(80% exact)/superato, TD04 subtraction (seed 09999999001 = 11000 superato, 2 anomalies), all 9 anomaly codes reproduced with crafted XMLs, anno filter on anomalies, detail progressivo, riepilogo, PDF upload/download/delete/validation (non-PDF, >5MB, bad kind 404), tenant isolation on GET/PUT/DELETE/file). Frontend: dashboard plafond-alert shows and links to /dichiarazioni; stats, year tabs, list/anomalie tabs, create via dialog (cliente prefill, invalid protocol toast, '/'-protocol normalized, comma decimal plafond), edit, detail sheet with PlafondBar + invoice list with TD04 negative, PDF upload/download/replace/delete, bad PDF toast, delete with confirm - all working. Mobile 390px: no page horizontal overflow, dialog and sheet usable.

minor.issue: Company deletion only blocks on invoices/users; dichiarazioni and dichiarazioni_files of that P.IVA are left orphaned (reproduced: company 09999999002 deleted with 1 declaration still in db, cleaned manually by me). Should block or cascade-delete dichiarazioni + files.

Invoices flagged fuori_periodo (other year or before ricevuta), revocata and cliente_diverso still erode the declaration's plafond (e.g. a 2025 invoice citing a 2026 protocol counted in 2026 utilizzato). Business decision: probably exclude at least other-year invoices from utilizzato, or document it.
Message uses non-Italian number format 'Plafond superato di 2000.00 €' (rest of UI uses 2.000,00 €).

ui_bugs.issue: api.delete calls without try/catch -> unhandled promise rejection and no error toast on failure
If data_revoca is set the badge always shows 'Revocata' (even for future revoca date) and hides 'Plafond superato'/'In esaurimento' state

issues: dich-data and dich-data-revoca use native browser date pickers (type=date) instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover
On edit plafond shows '5000.5' (dot) while user typed '5000,50'
Fatture table wrapper is overflow-hidden: 'Progressivo' column clipped on mobile; use overflow-x-auto

action_items: Make DELETE /api/companies/{vat} also check/cascade dichiarazioni + dichiarazioni_files
Decide whether fuori_periodo/revocata/cliente_diverso invoices should count toward utilizzato (at least exclude invoices of another year)
Format plafond_superato amount in Italian locale
Wrap delete calls in try/catch with toast
Replace native date inputs with shadcn Calendar; overflow-x-auto for detail invoice table
critical_code_review_comments: compute() runs backfill + full scan of all N3.5 invoices on every list/detail/riepilogo call (Dashboard calls riepilogo each load) - fine for MVP, may be slow for big archives
detail() recomputes all declarations to return one
download_pdf does not validate did is ObjectId/declaration exists (scoped by company_vat, so no leak)
anomalia testid anomalia-{codice}-{invoice_id} can duplicate when an invoice has 2 refs with same code
seed_data_creation: Test creates company 09999999002 + 11 TEST invoices + declarations and deletes them all in teardown (verified 0 leftovers). UI test created protocol 26019900000000001-000077 in 09999999001 and deleted it via UI. Main agent's 09999999001 data untouched.
